item.title: Deep Research (Gemini)
item.description:
This skill hands off research tasks to Google’s Gemini Deep Research agent for autonomous multi-step work — market analysis, competitive landscaping, and literature reviews.

Why a skill for this

Deep, multi-step research benefits from a purpose-built research agent rather than a general coding assistant improvising a research plan. Delegating to Gemini’s dedicated research agent gets a more thorough pass on that kind of task.
